data.name: Mateenah
data.gender_notes: Mateenah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 't-n-n', meaning to be firm or steadfast. In Islamic context, it refers to a person who is unwavering in their faith and actions, standing firm against adversity. The name Mateenah carries the meaning “Firm, Steady” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mateenah usually hope their child will grow to embody firm, steady and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of unwavering faith and strength.
data.etymology: Mateenah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Firm, Steady.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mateenah total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: متنة
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مؤنث يعني القوية أو الصلبة في اللغة العربية
in_arabic.long_meaning: متنة هو اسم علم مؤنث عربي، مشتق من الجذر 'م-ت-ن' الذي يعني القوة والصلابة. يشير الاسم إلى الشخصية القوية والصلبة، وقد ورد في بعض التفاسير القرآنية ذات الصلة بالقوة والمنعة. يستخدم هذا الاسم في الثقافة الإسلامية لتسمية المواليد الإناث، معبرًا عن الصفات الحميدة من القوة والصلابة.
